Data Engineer | Talent Community

 We Are Lennar 
 Lennar is one of the nation's leading homebuilders and a Fortune 500® company with a growing technology organization focused on innovation, data, digital experiences, and technology that helps shape the future of homebuilding.
 Data is at the center of that transformation. We're investing in modern data platforms and engineering capabilities that enable better decisions, smarter products, greater operational efficiency, and new ways of using data across the organization.

 Build Your Future in Data Engineering at Lennar 
 We're always looking to connect with talented Data Engineers who are excited about building the platforms and products that turn data into something our teams can use to make better decisions.
 This is a proactive talent community opportunity for Data Engineers interested in exploring future opportunities with Lennar. While we may not have an immediate opening that matches your background, we'd like to get to know you and stay connected as our Enterprise Data & Analytics organization continues to grow.
 Whether your expertise is in data platforms, data pipelines, cloud data engineering, data architecture, data integration, streaming, analytics engineering, or another area of data engineering , we welcome the opportunity to learn more about your experience and career interests.

 What You Could Work On 
 Depending on your background and future opportunities within the team, you may contribute to:
 Design, build, and operationalize scalable data engineering solutions for Lennar's data platforms and products.
 Build and optimize ETL and ELT pipelines that bring together data from diverse sources.
 Develop data ingestion and integration solutions using batch, incremental, change data capture (CDC), streaming, and API-based approaches.
 Design and implement data models, data warehouses, data lakes, and modern cloud data platforms.
 Build reliable, reusable, and maintainable data transformation processes that enable analysts, data scientists, and business teams to work with trusted data.
 Improve data quality, reliability, observability, monitoring, and error handling across data pipelines and platforms.
 Develop automated testing, CI/CD workflows, version control practices, and other engineering standards that improve the quality and speed of delivery.
 Partner with data analysts, data scientists, product teams, software engineers, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver data solutions that support real business outcomes.
 Help create self-service data capabilities that make it easier for teams across Lennar to access and use data.
 Contribute to data governance, security, compliance, and access-control practices.
 Troubleshoot complex data and platform issues and identify opportunities to improve performance, scalability, and maintainability.
 Stay current with emerging data technologies and engineering practices and help identify opportunities to apply them at Lennar.
 
 The Technologies You Could Work With 
 Our data environment continues to evolve, and future opportunities may span a variety of technologies, platforms, and architectural approaches.
 Depending on the role and team, experience with technologies such as the following may be relevant:
 AWS , including services such as S3, EMR, Glue, Lambda, EKS, EC2, and CloudWatch
 Snowflake and modern cloud data warehouse technologies
 dbt and modern analytics engineering practices
 SQL and Python 
 ETL/ELT, data ingestion, CDC, REST APIs, and streaming 
 Airflow, Prefect, or other orchestration and scheduling technologies 
 GitHub, CI/CD, automated testing, and modern software development practices 
 Data modeling, data warehousing, data lakes, and data architecture 
 Data governance, security, access controls, and data quality 
 Data replication and integration technologies such as Qlik Replicate 
 You don't need experience with every technology listed. We're interested in understanding the data challenges you've solved, the platforms you've built, and the technologies you're excited to work with next.

 What We're Looking For 
 We're interested in connecting with Data Engineers across a range of experience levels and specialties who bring:
 Professional experience designing, developing, and supporting data pipelines, platforms, products, or related engineering solutions.
 Strong understanding of data engineering fundamentals, including data modeling, transformation, ingestion, testing, monitoring, and data quality.
 Strong SQL skills and experience with one or more programming languages, such as Python.
 Experience working with cloud-based data platforms and modern data engineering technologies.
 Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to break down complex technical challenges.
 The ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and data consumers.
 A growth mindset and willingness to learn new technologies, tools, and approaches.
 An interest in understanding the business context behind the data and building solutions that create meaningful business value.
 A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field is preferred, or equivalent professional experience.
 For more senior opportunities, experience with data architecture, technical leadership, mentoring, platform strategy, and designing highly scalable data solutions may also be relevant.

 Why Join Lennar? 
 At Lennar, you'll have the opportunity to work on data challenges within a large, complex organization while helping build the capabilities that support our evolution into a more data and insights-driven company.
 You'll collaborate with professionals across data, analytics, software engineering, product, cybersecurity, and business functions , giving you the opportunity to work across a broad technology ecosystem and see how the solutions you build translate into real business impact.
 We're building a data organization that values technical excellence, problem solving, ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning . As our data capabilities evolve, so do the opportunities for engineers to expand their expertise, take on meaningful challenges, and build a career with impact.

 Interested in What's Next? 
 This is a proactive posting for our Data Engineering talent community and is not tied to a specific current opening. By expressing your interest, you'll have an opportunity to introduce yourself to our team and be considered for future Data Engineering opportunities that align with your experience, technical interests, and career goals.
 We'd love to learn more about you and stay connected as our Enterprise Data & Analytics organization grows.

 Physical & Office/Site Presence Requirements
 This is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the ability to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary.
 Travel may be required, up to 10% of the time, to locations within the Lennar family of companies.
 This description outlines the basic responsibilities and requirements for the position noted. This is not a comprehensive listing of all job duties. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
 Lennar is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws.

#IND-TECH
 
 Life at Lennar 
 
 At Lennar, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching environment for our Associates, offering a comprehensive array of benefits designed to enhance their well-being and professional growth. Our Associates have access to robust health insurance plans, including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage, ensuring their health needs are well taken care of. Our 401(k) Retirement Plan, complete with a $1 for $1 Company Match up to 5%, helps secure their financial future, while Paid Parental Leave and an Associate Assistance Plan provide essential support during life's critical moments. To further support our Associates, we provide an Education Assistance Program and up to $30,000 in Adoption Assistance, underscoring our commitment to their diverse needs and aspirations. From the moment of hire, they can enjoy up to three weeks of vacation annually, alongside generous Holiday, Sick Leave, and Personal Day policies. Additionally, we offer a New Hire Referral Bonus Program, significant Home Purchase Discounts, and unique opportunities such as the Everyone’s Included Day. At Lennar, we believe in investing in our Associates, empowering them to thrive both personally and professionally. Lennar Associates will have access to these benefits as outlined by Lennar’s policies and applicable plan terms. Visit Lennartotalrewards.com to view our suite of benefits. 
 
 Join the fun and follow us on social media to see what's happening at our company, and don't forget to connect with us on Lennar: Overview | LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/lennar/ > for the latest job opportunities.
 
 Lennar is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws.
